Show Cause Notice

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_report_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee Code: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Location: {{ doc.branch_name }}

It has been reported that due care has not been taken by you while discharging your job responsibilities. An allegation of {{ doc.case_type }} has been made against you. On {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_report_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, you {{ doc.description }}.

You are hereby informed that any violation of code of conduct, financial misappropriation, process lapses, behavioural lapses, or negligence in work on the part of any official of the company while discharging official responsibilities or any deviation from company policies is considered serious misconduct as per the policy and procedure of the company.

The aforesaid act of yours, if proved, will amount to a serious misconduct on your part and gross violation of company’s policy and procedures, attracting disciplinary action.

In view of the above, you are asked to explain why disciplinary action should not be initiated against you as per the policy of the company. You are advised to submit your written explanation within {{ doc.response_time }} of receipt of this letter, failing which the company will proceed as per available records on the presumption that you have no explanation and have accepted the above alleged charges.

For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society
name: Show Cause Notice
